{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Clean the 'revenue' column by removing commas and converting to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify internal test orders: those with revenue = 999,999.99
test_orders = df[df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]

# Filter for COMPLETED orders that are NOT internal test orders
completed_non_test = df[(df['status'] == 'completed') & (df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99)]

# Calculate total revenue from these orders
total_revenue = completed_non_test['revenue_clean'].sum()

# Output the result
total_revenue"}
